The rally was not uniform. Western Digital (WDC) dropped 17%, while Datadog (DDOG) declined 11%, showing that strong quarterly results did not always translate into higher share prices as investor expectations remained elevated.
For Palantir, the August surge underscores strong market momentum, but the sharp gain also leaves the stock more exposed to valuation and expectation risks.

title: Palantir Stock Leads August Rally -- Nvidia, Salesforce and Super Micro Jump
